sealed_statement.palette_split: In every authorized future state of the sealed all-positive Huang H_k family, X/D colors are confined to {1,2} and U colors to {3,4}.
sealed_statement.local_factor: Every extendable proper partial precoloring of one C7 clause induces an exact boundary relation R=(D1 x D2 x D3) intersect eq^{-1}(M) on the three pair states p_i=(x_i,d_i), where M is upward-closed in the equality bits.
sealed_statement.finite_authority: The constant C7 catalog exhausts 10125 partial precolorings, with 3357 extendable states, 70 distinct boundary relations and 14 distinct upward equality relations; candidate and independent enumeration agree.
sealed_statement.global_carrier: Intersect all unary four-state domains per variable, choose the coordinatewise maximal realizable equality bit e_i^max, and test each constant-size upward clause relation on e^max. This is exact by upward closure and local factorization.
sealed_statement.R1_R2: Any authorized R1/R2 query is represented by one or two temporary unary/local precolor restrictions followed by the same polynomial carrier test.
sealed_statement.update: On a successful force, sealed B2B1 performs canonical return; rebuilding the finite local factors and variable domains gives the next exact carrier without recursion.
sealed_statement.reconstruction: Choose one four-state variable assignment realizing e^max, set complement literals oppositely, and replay one stored constant local clause witness plus fixed/deleted receipts.
sealed_statement.complexity: Polynomial carrier size and polynomial query/update/reconstruction lifecycle; no enumeration of the 2^k E3 profiles.

explicit_nonclaims: No general polynomial carrier for arbitrary connected Q_ALL.
No use of Huang NP-hardness as a lower bound.
